column1: # Carpathian command table: one line per `carpatic <area> <verb>`.
# '@area|name|summary' lines set the order and the one-line description of an area.
# verb '*' = anything else is passed through to the tool. The completion command prints candidate words for the next argument.
# Editing this file is all it takes to add a command; man page and completions are generated/derived from it.
@area|theme|Colours, wallpapers, theme packs, Omarchy theme import
@area|wallpaper|Wallpapers: Carpathian scenes, your own pictures, Wallhaven, rotation
@area|intro|The login animation (mountains rise over your wallpaper)
@area|widgets|Desktop widgets: clock, calendar, weather and more (off until you turn them on)
@area|profile|The desktop you feel at home in (windows, macos, ubuntu, tiling, beginner)
@area|install|Install apps, AI tools, dev environments, web apps
@area|webapp|Web apps with their own window and profile
@area|compat|Run Ubuntu-only programs in a compatibility box
@area|hook|Scripts that run on events (theme change, update, screenshot)
@area|dotfiles|Keep your Carpathian settings in your own git repository
@area|trigger|Screenshot, screen recording, colour picker, clipboard history, share
@area|quicklook|Preview any file with Space, like on a Mac
@area|tour|The one-screen welcome to the keyboard-driven desktop
wallpaper|open|carpatic-wallpapers|||Open the wallpaper browser (Carpathian, My pictures, Wallhaven, Colours)
wallpaper|set|carpatic-wallpaper|set||Set the wallpaper from a path, id or title (--fill MODE, --theme, --light, --dark, --monitor NAME)
wallpaper|add|carpatic-wallpaper|add||Add a file, a folder or a wallhaven.cc link to My pictures
wallpaper|remove|carpatic-wallpaper|remove||Stop listing a folder or file (nothing is deleted)

wallpaper|rotate|carpatic-wallpaper|rotate|printf 'on
off
status
'|Change the picture on a timer or at login (on --every MIN --collection NAME, off, status)

wallpaper|collection|carpatic-wallpaper|collection|printf 'list
new
add
rm
show
'|Your own lists of pictures for rotation

wallpaper|wallhaven|carpatic-wallpaper|wallhaven|printf 'search
get
key
'|Search Wallhaven (safe for work only) or fetch one picture by id
wallpaper|accent|carpatic-wallpaper|accent||Suggest an accent colour from the wallpaper (--apply uses it)
wallpaper|pair|carpatic-wallpaper|pair||Different pictures for light and dark mode (pair light A dark B, pair off)

theme|pick|carpatic-theme-picker|show|printf 'theme
mode
wallpaper
accent
border
bordercolor
corners
gaps
buttons
icons
cursor
font
fontsize
mono
style
'|Open the theme picker: arrows change the theme, wallpaper, accent, borders, corners, gaps, icons, fonts

theme|wallpaper|carpatic-themepack|wallpaper|printf 'next
set
list
'|Next wallpaper, set one, or list them (next, set FILE, list)
theme|import|carpatic-themepack|import||Install a theme pack or an Omarchy theme directory
theme|convert|carpatic-themepack|convert||Check an Omarchy theme and print a conversion report
theme|share|carpatic-themepack|share|@themes|Export a theme and show how to hand it to a friend
theme|packs|carpatic-pack|list||Icon, cursor, GTK and font packs you can add

appearance|list|carpatic-appearance|list|printf 'fonts
icons
cursors
gtk
presets
'|List fonts, icons, cursors, gtk themes or presets
appearance|set|carpatic-appearance|set||Change one or more settings: set ui-font Inter ui-size 10
keys|list|carpatic-cheatsheet|list||Print the shortcuts of the active profile
keys|html|carpatic-cheatsheet|html||Write a printable HTML cheat sheet
keys|pdf|carpatic-cheatsheet|pdf||Write a printable PDF cheat sheet
keys|all|carpatic-cheatsheet|all||Write printable sheets (HTML and PDF) for every desktop style: all --out FOLDER
keys|json|carpatic-cheatsheet|json||The shortcuts as JSON, for scripts
menu|*|carpatic-menu|||Open the menu (optionally at a place: carpatic menu style)
install|dev|carpatic-dev|install|carpatic-dev names|Install a development environment (node, python, rust, go ...)
install|webapp|carpatic-webapp|add||Add a web app: install webapp NAME URL
install|tui|carpatic-tui|add||Add a terminal app launcher: install tui NAME COMMAND
dev|list|carpatic-dev|list||List development environments and which are installed
dev|status|carpatic-dev|status||Show versions of what is installed
dev|nvim-theme|carpatic-dev|nvim-theme||Regenerate the Neovim colours from your theme
webapp|add|carpatic-webapp|add||Add a web app: add NAME URL [--icon FILE]
webapp|preset|carpatic-webapp|preset|carpatic-webapp presets|Add a ready-made web app (youtube, github, gmail ...)
webapp|launch|carpatic-webapp|launch|carpatic-webapp names|Open a web app (or raise its window)
webapp|gui|carpatic-webapp|gui||Pick and add web apps from a menu
tui|add|carpatic-tui|add||Add a terminal app launcher: add NAME COMMAND
tui|preset|carpatic-tui|preset|carpatic-tui presets|Add a ready-made terminal app (btop, lazygit ...)
tui|launch|carpatic-tui|launch|carpatic-tui names|Open a terminal app (or raise its window)
ai|models|carpatic-ai|models||Local models: list, pull NAME, run NAME, rm NAME
ai|webui|carpatic-ai|webui||Chat web page for local models: start, stop, status, open
update|apply|carpatic-hook|wrap update -- carpatic-sudo carpatic-update apply||Take a snapshot, then update (runs your pre-update and post-update hooks)
rollback|restore|!carpatic-rollback|restore||Go back to a snapshot at the next restart
snapshot|restore|!carpatic-rollback|restore||Go back to a snapshot at the next restart
compat|run|carpatic-compat|run||Run a program inside the compatibility box
compat|shell|carpatic-compat|shell||Open a terminal in the box
compat|install|carpatic-compat|install||Install a .deb, AppImage or package in the box
compat|wrap|carpatic-compat|wrap||Put a command-line program in the box on your PATH
compat|list|carpatic-compat|list||List what you added to the box
hook|list|carpatic-hook|list||List hook points and your hooks
hook|run|carpatic-hook|run|carpatic-hook points|Run a hook by hand
hook|new|carpatic-hook|new|carpatic-hook points|Create a hook from a template and open it
hook|edit|carpatic-hook|edit|carpatic-hook points|Edit a hook in your editor
trigger|share|carpatic-trigger|share|printf 'clipboard\nfile\n'|Share the clipboard or a file as one download link on this network
quicklook|*|carpatic-quicklook|||Preview files without opening an app (Space in Files). Also: --on, --off, --status, --setup
tour|*|carpatic-tour|||Show the welcome card for the keyboard-driven desktop
system|info|carpatic-sysinfo|||Show this computer at a glance
system|doctor|carpatic-sysinfo|doctor||Check that the Carpathian tools are all in place

intro|set|carpatic-intro|set|printf 'first-login-only
every-login
off
'|Choose when it plays: first-login-only, every-login or off
intro|status|carpatic-intro|status||Show the setting and whether it would play now
intro|reset|carpatic-intro|reset||Let it play again at the next login
screensaver|status|carpatic-screensaver|status||Show the settings and whether it would start now

screensaver|set|carpatic-screensaver|set|printf 'on
off
timeout
effect
battery
'|Turn it on or off, or: set timeout 5, set effect rain, set battery yes
widgets|enable|carpatic-widgets|enable||Turn widgets on (they are off by default)
widgets|disable|carpatic-widgets|disable||Turn widgets off completely; nothing keeps running
widgets|status|carpatic-widgets|status||Say whether widgets are on and which ones are on the desktop
widgets|list|carpatic-widgets|list||Every widget you can add, and which ones are on
widgets|add|carpatic-widgets|add|carpatic-widgets ids off|Put a widget on the desktop: add weather L
widgets|remove|carpatic-widgets|remove|carpatic-widgets ids on|Take a widget off the desktop
widgets|move|carpatic-widgets|move||Place a widget on the grid: move clock 4 0
widgets|edit|carpatic-widgets|edit||Drag, resize, add and remove widgets
widgets|peek|carpatic-widgets|peek||Show the widgets above your windows until you press a key

widgets|todo|carpatic-widgets|todo|printf 'add
list
done
clear
'|The to-do list: todo add Buy bread
widgets|note|carpatic-widgets|note||Show or set the sticky note
widgets|monitor|carpatic-widgets|monitor||Which screen shows the widgets: monitor primary, monitor 1
widgets|doctor|carpatic-widgets|doctor||Check what this computer can do for widgets
